instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_024_batch_scale_parts.step in SolidWorks. Using SolidWorks command-line automation, use that input file containing independent solids bracket_A, bracket_B, and bracket_C. Bracket_A is 60 x 40 x 20 mm centered at X=0, bracket_B starts as 60 x 40 x 20 mm centered at X=65, and bracket_C is 55 x 35 x 18 mm centered at X=145. Scale only bracket_B uniformly by factor 1.25 while preserving its local origin position at X=65, Y=0. Do not change bracket_A or bracket_C. Export the complete assembly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_024_scaled_assembly_out.step. Also export C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_024_A.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_024_B_scaled.step, and C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_024_C.step as separate part STEP files using each part's own centered local coordinates. [Software] Launch SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` (use your actual executable or shortcut). Before starting the work, run the SOLIDWORKS automation through `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe` when working on `cli_024_batch_scale_parts.step`.
